environment.capture_note: Run evidence immutable after registration; negative execution source retained as snapshots/transactions.mjs.

acceptance.contract: Bounded separate MSE buffers: paused/future AAC audio replacement, compatible video queue, future AVC configuration changes. Frequency/color/dimension observation only, not gapless PCM or numbered-frame qualification.
acceptance.baseline: Existing all-old audio/small video/initial red prefix and preserved exact SourceBuffer objects.
acceptance.oracle: Observed expected tones/colors/dimensions, seek/EOF and exact object identities; not sample/frame exact.

performance.reason: Feasibility and lifecycle screen; no benchmark run.

limits: No sample-exact gapless PCM or numbered-frame oracle.
Invalid MIME is preflight rejection, not failing-append rollback.
Synchronous generation check is not in-flight transport cancellation.
Explicit fixed finite queue, no measured long-run retained memory.
